title: Strioline
description: An experimental, unofficial Vulkan-based variant of Fabulously Optimized that replaces the standard rendering stack with VulkanMod while keeping as much of FO’s performance and quality-of-life design as possible.
body:
## Strioline

This project is an **experimental Vulkan-based variant** of the well-known **[Fabulously Optimized](https://modrinth.com/modpack/fabulously-optimized)** modpack.

It aims to preserve as much of the original **Fabulously Optimized (FO)** experience as possible while **replacing the traditional OpenGL/Sodium rendering stack with VulkanMod**. The goal is to explore potential performance improvements and alternative rendering paths on supported systems.

## About Fabulously Optimized

**Fabulously Optimized** is a community-driven modpack focused on:

* High performance
* Visual improvements
* OptiFine parity features
* Stability and quality-of-life enhancements

This project would not exist without the original FO team and their excellent work.
**All core design philosophy, mod choices (where compatible), and configuration direction originate from the FO project.**

This is **not an official FO release** and is **not maintained by the FO team**.

## What’s Different in This Edition

This variant replaces FO’s standard rendering stack with:

* **VulkanMod** as the rendering backend
* Removal of mods that are incompatible with Vulkan rendering
* Adjustments to maintain stability under a non-OpenGL renderer

Because VulkanMod fundamentally changes how Minecraft renders graphics, some visual or performance-related FO features may be missing, altered, or behave differently.

## Experimental Status

**This modpack is experimental.**

You should expect:

* Rendering bugs
* Visual glitches
* Feature regressions compared to standard FO
* Incompatibility with certain resource packs, shaders, or rendering mods

This pack is intended for users who are comfortable testing, troubleshooting, and reporting issues — not for players seeking a fully stable experience.

## Compatibility Notes

Due to the use of VulkanMod:

* Shader support differs from standard FO (Iris/Sodium shaders are not used)
* Some rendering enhancement mods from FO are intentionally removed
* Visual parity with the main FO pack is not guaranteed

If you want the fully supported and polished experience, please use the **official Fabulously Optimized modpack** instead.

## Credits

* **Fabulously Optimized Team** — Original modpack design and curation
* **VulkanMod Developers** — Vulkan rendering backend for Minecraft
* All original mod authors included in the pack
